notes: Small training-method precedence hardening. The strictest current requirement now always wins across replacement-version training impact, linked training-pack decisions and per-person overrides. A replacement version marked Self-training can still be upgraded to Instructor-led when a valid linked pack or individual override requires it. A No-retraining carry-forward cannot incorrectly preserve a prior self-training completion when the person's current pack now requires instructor-led evidence; it only carries as complete when the prior evidence itself satisfies the current instructor requirement. Existing instructor-led completion can still be carried where No retraining was deliberately selected. Toolbox Talks remain instructor-led always. No database migration was required.
